deviations: Same structural constraint as the prior T1 closure JSON: the commit's own final SHA cannot be embedded inside a file that is part of that same commit (the SHA is a hash of the tree, which includes the file). I committed the single content change first, captured that HEAD SHA, wrote this JSON referencing it, then used `git commit --amend --no-edit` (same commit message, no new commit -- still exactly one commit for this fix) to fold the JSON in. `commit_sha` above is therefore the pre-amend intermediate SHA (`8006f65fd787d9370024de47a4a81c003c30f232`), one hop behind the true final HEAD reported in the closing message. Per the coordinator's explicit allowance ('you may omit commit_sha or state it as the pre-amend value again'), I am stating it as the pre-amend value again.
